header.what: Canonical scored-output mirror for the season-aware answer scorer.
header.why: The season_resolution bench and its scorer live in dime-internal/evals/dimebench (dime/ stays code-only), which Instinct QA cannot access. This fixture mirrors scorer behavior/verdicts in dime so QA can verify without repo access. Generated from the canonical scorer, not hand-typed.
rules: season_consistency(facts, answer): 1.0 unless the answer names a different season than facts['season'].
Only applies when facts carry a 'season' label ('2024-25' / '2024-2025' / en-dash tolerant, canonicalized to YYYY-YY).
An answer naming no season is NOT penalized (1.0). An explicit wrong-season claim zeroes it (0.0).
numeric_acc: numeric-form matching with trailing-digit guard; the season gate zeroes it first on a season mismatch.
header.regen: fetch evals/dimebench/scoring.py from dime-internal and rerun the generation snippet; do not hand-edit expected values.
